scope: Versioned runtime settings and authenticated HTTP with simulated MCU PWM
checks: Target and min/max speed validate and commit atomically
Repeated request returns its original receipt; conflicting or stale requests fail
External changes including change-and-restore invalidate tokens
Maintenance, close, reload and delayed authorization cannot retain stale authority
HTTP update changes cooling PWM on a subsequent temperature sample

benchmark.scope: Registry dispatch, state tokens, validation and receipts; no HTTP transport or sensor/PWM IO

limitations: Settings receipt is not physical output acknowledgement
Settings are runtime-only and reset on reload
SPI fan combination, compiled loaded printing and hardware acceptance remain pending
No Python retired; historical Node crashes and motion numerical mismatches remain unresolved
